# Stampr

> Stampr is a digital loyalty platform designed for Philippine local businesses, their staff, and customers. The current release is a frontend-only product demo powered by local JSON; no live backend or delivery provider is connected yet.

## Canonical pages

- Product: /product
- Features: /features
- Pricing and cost estimator: /pricing
- Philippine digital loyalty guide: /loyalty-program-philippines
- Complete FAQ: /faq
- Industry solutions: /solutions
- Comparisons: /compare/gobalik, /compare/suki-cards, /compare/zap
- Privacy direction: /privacy

## Product surfaces

- Customer: installable Next.js PWA with one private QR, wallet, discovery, notifications, history, channel preferences, exports, leave, and deletion requests.
- Business and staff: Next.js web app with scanning, joining, customers, eight program types, favorite orders, birthday journeys, redemptions, campaigns, delivery logs, analytics, roles, integrations, and billing/privacy controls.
- Platform administration: Next.js web app with tenant health, privacy operations, service queues, support, audit, unit economics, and network-wide policies.
- Public website: product education, pricing, industries, resources, comparisons, buyer FAQ, and contact journey.
- Planned backend: one shared FastAPI service plus one background worker, developed locally with Docker before deployment.

## Pricing direction in Philippine pesos

- Launch: ₱0/month; 250 active members, 1 location, 1 program, 2 staff.
- Core: ₱499 monthly or ₱399/month billed annually; 1,500 active members, 1 location, 2 programs, 5,000 email allowance, 3 staff.
- Grow: ₱1,290 monthly or ₱990/month billed annually; 10,000 active members, 3 locations, all 8 program formats, 25,000 email allowance, 100 SMS credits.
- Scale: ₱3,490 monthly or ₱2,790/month billed annually; 50,000 active members, 10 locations, 50 staff, integrations, 100,000 email allowance, 500 SMS credits.
- SMS over allowance: ₱0.95 per 160-character segment. Longer messages may use multiple segments.
- Email over allowance: ₱25 per 1,000. In-app and web push are included under fair use.

## Important accuracy notes

- Features described as demo, planned, direction, or ready for provider connection are not claims of a live production service.
- Privacy workflows are designed to support good practice and Philippine data-protection operations; software alone does not guarantee legal compliance.
- Comparison pages use competitors’ public information observed on August 25, 2026 and link to primary sources. Verify current terms with each provider.
